description_en: Queries the status and download URL of an invisible watermark embedding task
description_zh: 查询暗水印嵌入任务的状态及下载URL
name: GetWatermarkEmbedTaskResult

parameters.help_en: A reserved idempotency field. This field is not supported. Passing a value does not cause an error, but it does not produce an idempotency effect
parameters.help_zh: 预留幂等字段，暂不支持。传入不会报错，但当前不产生幂等效果
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The invisible watermark task ID returned by the CreateWatermarkEmbedTask operation
parameters.help_zh: 暗水印任务 ID，由 CreateWatermarkEmbedTask 接口返回
parameters.name: task_id

Code.description_en: The business error code. The value OK is returned if the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。 请求成功时返回 "OK"

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value 200 is returned if the request is successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。 请求成功时返回 200

Message.description_en: The failure reason when the task fails. This parameter is returned only when Status is failed
Message.description_zh: 任务失败时的失败原因。仅在 Status 为 failed 时返回
Message.title_en: 任务失败时的错误信息
Message.title_zh: 任务失败时的错误信息

Status.description_en:
The task status. The processing time is approximately equal to the media duration. Valid values:
pending: The task is waiting.
running: The task is running.
succeeded: The task succeeded.
failed: The task failed
Status.description_zh: 任务状态，取值：pending（等待中）、running（执行中）、succeeded（成功）、failed（失败）；处理耗时约与媒体时长相当
Status.title_en: 任务状态，取值：pending（等待中）、running（执行中）、succeeded（成功）、failed（失败）；处理耗时约与媒体时长相当
Status.title_zh: 任务状态，取值：pending（等待中）、running（执行中）、succeeded（成功）、failed（失败）；处理耗时约与媒体时长相当

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

TaskId.description_en: The invisible watermark embedding task ID

Url.description_en: The pre-signed URL for accessing the watermarked file. This parameter is returned only when Status is succeeded
Url.description_zh: 嵌入水印后的文件预签名访问 URL。仅在 Status 为 succeeded 时返回
Url.title_en: 嵌入水印后的文件预签名访问URL，任务成功后返回
Url.title_zh: 嵌入水印后的文件预签名访问URL，任务成功后返回
